title: Community Data Administrator
description:
About us

We are a leading integrated media and marketing services company at the heart of a community of over 590,000 UK healthcare professionals. With more than 30 years of experience, we produce industry-leading content and experiences through our award-winning brands, publications, and events. We produce trusted, data-driven content that informs and inspires healthcare professionals across the UK and Europe. We are a Great Place to Work and UK's Best Workplaces for Women certified employer, offering a range of benefits including 28 days annual leave (rising to 30 days after 2 years) excluding bank holidays, private healthcare insurance, flexible working and more.

The Role

Our Community Data Administrator will be responsible for the quality, coverage, depth and development of the organisation's HCP community. The role will ensure we have a high-quality, accurate, comprehensive, current, relevant and growing audience that meets the needs of the business and our clients.

They will develop a detailed understanding of the organisation's HCP data and the wider addressable HCP market, identifying where we have strong coverage, where gaps exist and what actions we can take to address them. They will use first- and third-party data, market intelligence and behavioural and engagement data to understand the composition and health of our community and identify opportunities for growth and improvement.

This is a highly analytical role for someone who loves working with data, numbers and solving problems. They will interrogate datasets, spot patterns and anomalies, assess data quality and freshness, identify gaps and translate findings into clear actions.

Working closely with teams across the organisation, they will help source and evaluate new data, improve HCP profiling and segmentation, strengthen our understanding of audience engagement and ensure our HCP community becomes increasingly accurate, complete, current and commercially valuable.

Location: Central London (Hybrid)

Reporting to: Digital Director

Expected start date: January 2027

Salary: £30,000 to £38,000 per annum, depending on experience

Key Responsibilities:

Data Quality & Governance

Take ownership of the overall health of the organisation's HCP database, including accuracy, completeness, recency, duplication, consistency, consent and compliance. Establish clear definitions and standards for data quality and regularly measure the database against them, including agreed definitions for active HCPs, inactive HCPs, dormant records, complete profiles and verified HCPs. Identify data quality issues and work with relevant teams to implement solutions and continually improve the reliability of our data.

HCP Coverage & Gap Analysis

Build a detailed understanding of the organisation's coverage of the HCP market and identify gaps by profession, specialty, geography, seniority and other relevant characteristics. Develop clear, data-led plans to address priority audience gaps and measure the impact of actions taken.

Data Enrichment

Identify opportunities to enhance existing HCP records with additional data points and attributes, improving the completeness and depth of our profiles. Determine which additional attributes would provide the greatest audience, editorial and commercial value and identify appropriate sources for obtaining them.

Data Freshness & Engagement

Assess how recently and frequently HCPs interact with the organisation across our brands, websites, newsletters, events, CPD platforms, surveys and other products. Develop and maintain an HCP engagement scoring methodology that combines behavioural signals across the business to provide a consistent view of audience engagement. Use engagement and recency data to understand the active audience within our overall community and identify opportunities to increase engagement.

Audience Re-engagement & Cleansing

Identify inactive, ageing, duplicate, incomplete or low-confidence records. Work with relevant teams to determine appropriate approaches for re-engagement, verification, consolidation, suppression or removal. Monitor the effectiveness of re-engagement and cleansing activity and use the findings to continually improve our approach.

Data Matching & Deduplication

Develop approaches for identifying duplicate HCP records and matching individuals across different the organisation datasets, platforms and data sources. Investigate conflicting information and establish appropriate rules for determining the most reliable and current information. Support the development of an increasingly consistent and accurate single view of each HCP across the organisation.

Segmentation & Audience Insight

Develop meaningful HCP segments based on profession, specialty, geography, seniority, demographics, behaviour, engagement, recency and other relevant characteristics. Analyse these segments to identify patterns, opportunities and changes in audience behaviour. Translate complex data into clear insights that can be understood and acted upon by teams across the business.

Data Acquisition & Gap Closure

Research and evaluate new first- and third-party data sources that could strengthen the organisation's HCP community. Assess potential sources based on quality, coverage, accuracy, recency, compliance, cost and likely incremental value. Develop data-led recommendations for acquiring or generating data to address identified audience gaps and measure whether those interventions successfully improve coverage.

Commercial Audience Analysis

Work closely with Sales and other commercial teams to understand current and emerging client audience requirements. Translate these requirements into data needs and assess the organisation's ability to reach relevant HCP audie
